intro.title: Michael Kobtsev
intro.subtitle: Senior Full-Stack Engineer · Tech Lead
intro.description: I build AI-powered products end to end: web, mobile, backend, cloud and payments. Python, TypeScript, React, Node.js, LLM agents and tools.

about.text: Hi, I'm Michael — a <0>Full-Stack Engineer with 7+ years of commercial experience</0>, including Team Lead and Tech Lead roles.<1></1><1></1>Since 2021 I've worked at <0>Businessware Technologies</0>, an AI software development company, on long-term client projects. I build <0>products with AI inside</0>: LLM agents and tools (OpenAI Agents SDK, MCP, RAG), AI cost control, document and video AI pipelines — and take them from architecture to production, including mobile releases, infrastructure and payments.<1></1><1></1>I spend part of the year in Russia and part in Thailand (UTC+3…+7) and work remotely with international teams. <0>Open to Senior / Tech Lead roles and contract projects.</0>

bf.position: React, Python Full-Stack<0></0>Team Lead / Tech Lead
bf.description: AI wildfire detection on live 360° cameras in California and Australia, with alerts to emergency services. I led the team (hiring, onboarding, planning, client communication) and was the main contributor to the web app: camera views, detections and a large admin panel on React + GraphQL (AWS AppSync), plus the serverless AWS backend.

wo.description: Construction takeoff tool — "AutoCAD in the browser" with AI detection of walls, doors, windows and rooms. I led the front-end team from the start: geometry editor, PDF workflows, a YOLO model running in the browser on ONNX Runtime Web, performance tuning for heavy drawings.

fs.description: No-code platform for training computer-vision models (classification, detection, segmentation) and exporting them as Android apps. I built core pages, dataset upload and training flows, the annotation canvas, authentication and subscriptions.

ic.description: Commercial website for an exporter of polymers, fertilizers and sulphur: product and price search, maps, adaptive layout.

amdb.description: Service for the Institute of Cytology and Genetics to store, search and analyse research and experiments.

hobbio.description: My own small startup: hobby, event and place discovery app for iOS, Android and web. I build it end to end — Expo app with 110+ store releases, NestJS backend with queues, YooKassa subscriptions, Kubernetes.

inqi.description: AEC/GIS platform for site planning: ArcGIS-based web editor, iOS/Android app, geometry and export services and an AI assistant. I designed the AI spend-control system, worked on the assistant (OpenAI Agents SDK, MCP tools on AWS Lambda, SSE), built Stripe subscriptions with AI credits and shipped 60+ mobile releases.

aid.description: AI analysis of digital stethoscope recordings. Desktop app with device connection, cloud sync and auto-update. I built the AWS infrastructure and the Node.js backend for storing and syncing device data, with a firmware / app version registry.

reelabs.description: My own small startup: Telegram-first service for AI video reels — LLM scripts, HeyGen avatars, ElevenLabs voice, Remotion rendering on AWS Lambda, YooKassa billing.

bw.position: Senior Full-Stack Engineer · Team Lead / Tech Lead
bw.description: AI software development company (since 2003) building AI agents, document AI and SaaS products for international clients. I work on long-term client projects, usually two in parallel — the main ones are below.
bw.other: Also AI projects for other clients: LLM extraction of purchase orders from email and PDF into ERP (Gemini, FastAPI, Azure), SKU matching with hybrid retrieval and ML ranking (Qdrant, LightGBM), speech-to-clips video pipeline (Whisper, GPT), multi-agent document review with RAG (LangGraph, pgvector).

news.description: AI pipeline for European regional newspaper publishers that turns static PDF issues into interactive ones: a YOLO model finds ad blocks on each page, Gemini confirms the ad and extracts its URL, and validated links are inserted at the exact coordinates. I built the Python / FastAPI service and the event-driven cloud setup on GCP and S3.
